appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Your company's brand: title, colors, logo and favicon. There is one for the whole wiki; every area looks the same.
appearance.site_title_hint: Shown in the browser tab, the top bar and the sign-in page. Up to 40 characters; empty means “Kudawiki”.
appearance.company_hint: Shown in the footer and when printing.
appearance.login_message_hint: Plain text below the form. E.g.: “For authorized staff only. Activity is logged.”
appearance.powered_by: Show “Powered by Kudawiki” in the footer
appearance.locked: Set in the configuration file: it can't be changed here.
appearance.primary_hint: Side menu, buttons, links and focus.
appearance.header_hint: The bar's text turns white or near-black on its own, by contrast.
appearance.own_sidebar: Use a different color for the side menu
appearance.sidebar_hint: Useful when the primary color is too light for a large background.
appearance.fixed_colors: The 🔒 N2/N3 levels, callouts, history changes and error or success states don't take the brand color: they mean the same in every wiki.
appearance.preview_text: This is how text looks, with a
appearance.reset_hint: Reset puts the texts and colors back to Kudawiki's; it applies when you save. Logos are removed one by one, below.
appearance.kind_hint.logo: SVG, PNG or WebP, up to 1 MB. It shows 32 px tall in the bar: horizontal works best.
appearance.kind_hint.logo_dark: Optional. For a dark top bar and dark mode; without it, the logo is used.
appearance.kind_hint.favicon: Square. If you don't upload one, it's made from the logo.
appearance.unsupported: That file isn't a usable image. SVG, PNG or WebP are accepted.
appearance.warning.link_darkened: Your color is too light for text; links will use {color}.
appearance.warning.favicon_not_square: The favicon isn't square: it will look shrunk or padded in the tab.
appearance.warning.logo_too_small: The logo is under 64 px tall: it will look blurry on high-density screens. An SVG or a larger PNG works better.
appearance.warning.logo_low_contrast: The logo barely stands out from the top bar color. Try another bar color or upload a logo for dark backgrounds.
appearance.warning.svg_not_rasterized: This SVG couldn't be turned into an image (it uses unsupported filters or fonts), so there are no tab icons. Upload a PNG favicon too.

mdguide.title: How to write in Markdown
mdguide.intro: Markdown is plain text with a few marks; the preview shows the result right away. The page title has its own field at the top: no need to repeat it with #.
mdguide.keys_note: On a Mac, use Cmd instead of Ctrl. E, G H and Ctrl+K work while reading a page.
